decisions.basis: Explicit four-group classifications from observed diet evidence; only recorded substantial food groups. No diet inference or species-richness claim.
Exact decimal coordinate arithmetic from the published Sechrest 2003 range bounds in PanTHERIA; one mapped-range prize per board.

The MacLean 2014 study measures two particular food tasks, not universal intelligence. Primary paper verified from Virginia Tech author manuscript; clear-tube task uses four-of-five training criterion and ten transparent-cylinder test trials. Further exact species matching and uncertainty audit required; generic Orangutan and Capuchin labels are not silently assigned to species.

Published compilation traced to primary papers, including an author-hosted Veilleux & Kirk 2014 manuscript. Original numerical supplement and cohort/method provenance remain incomplete. Canis lupus entries may be domestic dogs; no wolf substitution. Behavioral and anatomically calculated visual acuity cannot be combined as measured vision.

Brumm et al. 2025 supplies calibrated field data and 17 songbird species with bird-level IDs and distance correction. Author metadata and README verified; raw CSV download returned 403 in this environment. Decibels need logarithmic-aware separation, not a raw 5% ratio.
